(2) Include the whole word "linen" ignoring case. (3) Do not use the whole word "urgent" ignoring case. (4) No digits. (5) Exactly 2 nonempty paragraphs separated by a blank line. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".

Dear team, The linen sample remains on the review table. This week's follow-through depends on a clear statement from the review team's co-ordinator. The well-tested plan isn't ready for a final sign-off until the team's review is complete. Each team member can read the plain-language summary before choosing an after-lunch meeting slot. An up-to-date list will help the day-shift staff prepare for the next hand-over meeting. We shouldn't replace the working copy with a draft whose check-in notes haven't been reviewed. Please re-check the hand-written notes and keep the follow-up record beside the sample tray. Leave the blue-green label on the sample box so that the evening crew can find it. We can ask the group's point-person to gather the left-over papers after the final check. The back-up record belongs in the shared folder rather than the personal note-book on the desk. A careful cross-check can prevent an out-of-date copy from reaching the next review group. The co-owner's brief message should explain why the pre-approved materials remain on the shelf. The re-usable folders belong beside the front-desk register while the meeting room is closed. An easy-to-read note can describe the changes without repeating every step in yesterday's message. Please keep the meeting's pre-work separate from the notes that still need a second check.

Kind regards.

Dear team,

I wanted to provide a quick update on the Harrison project and outline the next steps. We’ve made substantial progress this week, successfully completing the initial design phase and receiving positive feedback from the client regarding the proposed aesthetic. The color palettes, particularly the incorporation of softer hues and natural materials – think woven textures and beautiful linen – appear to be resonating well. We are now transitioning into the development stage, which will involve building the core functionality and integrating the user interface. This phase requires close collaboration between the front-end and back-end teams to ensure seamless integration and a consistent user experience. Please prioritize clear communication and frequent check-ins to address any potential roadblocks proactively. Remember to document all code thoroughly and adhere to the established style guidelines. We also need to finalize the content strategy, ensuring all messaging is clear, concise, and aligns with the client’s brand voice. 

To ensure a smooth workflow, let’s schedule a brief meeting tomorrow afternoon to discuss individual tasks and dependencies. Please come prepared to share your progress and any challenges you anticipate. The deadline for the initial prototype is approaching, so focused effort is needed. While things are proceeding well, let's maintain our commitment to quality and attention to detail. Let’s continue to support each other and maintain a positive and collaborative spirit. Your dedication and hard work are greatly appreciated, and I am confident that we will deliver an exceptional product. I am available for any questions or concerns you may have. 

Kind regards.
